day.art: An activity ring beside bars for protein, carbs, fat and fiber
day.body: The ring fills as you log. Switch on protein, carbs, fat, fiber and sugar to follow your macros alongside calories.
day.title: Your day at a glance

log.art: An entry field above three ways to add food: type, barcode, photo
log.artNoAi: An entry field above two ways to add food: type, barcode
log.body: Type the calories, scan a barcode, or take a photo and let AI estimate it — whichever is fastest. Foods you eat often become one-tap favourites.
log.bodyNoAi: Type the calories or scan a barcode — whichever is faster. Foods you eat often become one-tap favourites.
log.title: Three ways to log a meal
log.titleNoAi: Two ways to log a meal

plan.art: A weight line falling toward a target marker
plan.body: Log your weight, pick a target, and Schautrack works out the daily calorie budget that gets you there.
plan.title: Set a goal, get a budget

share.art: Two weeks of day squares joined by a link
share.body: Set your goals, switch on daily todos and notes, and link accounts to follow someone else's day next to your own.
share.title: Make it yours

welcome.art: A week of day squares, today still empty
welcome.body: Schautrack keeps one number in view: what you have eaten today. Every day you log fills in a square.
welcome.title: One day at a time
